evidence: STATUS_BY_KIND maps DomainErrorKind values to HTTP status codes (404/400/409). This translates domain errors to HTTP, which is transport work.
errorHandlerMiddleware(error, _req, res, _next) is an Express error middleware that uses res.status(...).json(...). This is framework/transport code.
SyntaxError is mapped to 400 'Malformed JSON body'. This is about parsing the HTTP request body, not a business rule.
The fallback returns 500 'Internal server error'. This is generic transport behaviour.
parsedVerdict.reasoning: The file is an Express error-handling middleware. Its only job is transport. It maps domain error kinds to HTTP status codes and turns errors into JSON HTTP responses. That is framework/transport adapter logic, which belongs in an infrastructure layer. The file makes no business decisions, does no persistence work and does not orchestrate use cases. It only translates errors that already exist into HTTP responses.
